name: Harley-Davidson Sportster S
engine: 1252 cc liquid-cooled Revolution Max V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: The liquid-cooled Sportster. Check the upper triple clamp recall before riding.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2021-2026 Sportster S bikes are in recall 26V075 because the upper triple clamp may fracture. It expands the earlier recall 25V590, so bikes fixed under that one need the new fix too.
A-002.reason: A broken triple clamp can cost you steering. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Upper triple clamp may fracture. Expands recall 25V590.
Instrument cluster may not show the speedometer and neutral light when cold.
recalls.fix: Dealer updates the cluster software free.
